properties.headline: High Surf Advisory issued July 20 at 7:12AM HST until July 21 at 6:00PM HST by NWS Honolulu HI
properties.description:
...HIGH SURF ADVISORY FOR SOUTH FACING SHORES THROUGH TUESDAY...

.A moderate, long-period south swell will hold at advisory levels
through Tuesday afternoon. The swell should begin to fade by
Tuesday night or Wednesday, allowing surf to drop below advisory
thresholds.

* WHAT...Surf 7 to 10 feet.

* WHERE...South facing shores of all Hawaiian Islands.

* WHEN...Until 6 PM HST Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Moderate. Strong breaking waves and strong currents
will make swimming dangerous.
properties.instruction:
Heed all advice from ocean safety officials. When in doubt, don't
go out.

NWSheadline: HIGH SURF ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 6 PM HST TUESDAY
